Meanwhile the day also brought a reality check: OpenAI published a framework for reporting model incidents along with six concrete cases, Databricks admits its coding costs jumped 60% after switching to Astra, and Zuckerberg publicly rejected calls to slow down AI development. Closer to home, Anthropic now has an official Claude ambassador for Serbia.
